abort.discovery_only: HA Windows Bridge is discovered automatically after the Windows application connects to MQTT.
abort.invalid_discovery: The MQTT discovery message is invalid.
abort.no_entities: No entities are enabled in the Windows application.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Do you want to add **{name}**? All enabled controls, switches, sensors and the Media Player will appear in one HA Windows Bridge integration.

user.title: Add direct Windows overlay
user.description: Creates a local WebSocket endpoint for overlays without an MQTT broker. Enter the same device ID shown in the Windows app.

show_saved_overlay.name: Display saved popup
show_saved_overlay.description: Displays the design selected in the computer's Saved popup entity and fills it with the entities chosen below. Select option only changes the active design.

template_entity.name: Computer popup list
template_entity.description: Select the Saved popup entity belonging to the target computer.

template_id.name: Template ID
template_id.description: Optional advanced override of the currently selected popup.

message_entity.name: Value or message entity
message_entity.description: Uses the entity state or selected attribute as the main popup value or message.

image_entity.name: Camera or image entity
image_entity.description: Fetches the current still image from a camera or image entity.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: Optional HTTP(S) URL or image data URI.

show_overlay.name: Display Windows overlay
show_overlay.description: Displays a customizable card with a message or information about currently playing media.

title.name: Title
title.description: Short heading displayed at the top of the card.

message.name: Message
message.description: Main card content. Optional when a media source is selected.

media.name: Current Windows media
media.description: Uses the active media session on the target Windows computer.

media_player_entity.name: Home Assistant media player
media_player_entity.description: Uses the selected player's title, artist, artwork and playback progress.

layout.name: Content layout
layout.description: Automatic mode selects a layout from the supplied content. Status emphasizes a short value; Indicator creates a small icon, image or value capsule.

display_mode.name: Display mode
display_mode.description: Queue shows one card at a time. Side by side keeps up to four cards visible together and wraps them when space is limited.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Higher-priority cards move ahead of ordinary queued messages.

notification_id.name: Message ID
notification_id.description: Identifier used to update or remove this card later.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: MDI icon displayed next to the title.

image.name: Image
image.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image supplied as a data URI (up to 512 KiB).

qr.name: QR code
qr.description: Text or URL encoded as a QR code.

progress.name: Progress value
progress.description: Fills the progress bar from 0 to 100%.

progress_entity.name: Progress entity
progress_entity.description: Reads the value from an entity state or selected attribute.

duration.name: Display duration
duration.description: Time before the card closes automatically.

duration_entity.name: Duration entity
duration_entity.description: Reads the display duration from an entity state or selected attribute.

pause_on_hover.name: Pause while hovered
pause_on_hover.description: Pauses automatic closing while the pointer is over the card.

show_lifetime.name: Lifetime bar
show_lifetime.description: Shows the remaining display time at the bottom of the card.

edge_offset.name: Edge offset
edge_offset.description: Moves the visible card inward from the selected screen edges.

monitor.name: Monitor
monitor.description: Optional monitor number. When omitted, uses the setting from the Windows app.

size_mode.name: Size adjustment
size_mode.description: Automatic mode fits the card to its content; manual mode accepts custom dimensions.

opacity.name: Background opacity
opacity.description: Controls the card surface without dimming text or icons.

background_effect.name: Background effect
background_effect.description: Choose a solid surface, standard background blur or layered Liquid Glass.

preset.name: Accent color
preset.description: Applies a contextual color to the border, icon and progress bar.

update_overlay.name: Update Windows overlay
update_overlay.description: Updates a displayed or queued card with the selected ID.

remove_overlay.name: Remove Windows overlay
remove_overlay.description: Removes the displayed or queued card with the selected ID.

clear_overlay.name: Clear Windows overlays
clear_overlay.description: Closes all current and queued Windows overlay cards.
